title: The Group's website carries the brief's three stats, links nothing to the old site, and North Park reads North Park

source.ref: The Group handoff (2026-10-19) section H: replace the stats with the brief's (Nearly 100 businesses launched, chapters and growing, Every Friday rain or shine), remove the links to thegroupcoastal.com and thegroupportal.com and move those actions onto Frequency, fix North Park's Normal Heights text, keep Powered by Frequency footer-only.

detail: The home stat tiles read Nearly 100 businesses launched, the live chapter count and growing (six today, from CHAPTERS.length, not the brief's four, so the tile never contradicts the chapters section beside it), and Every Friday rain or shine. Sign up to pitch and Speak on a Friday go to the website's contact page (no form block exists yet; the Be a guest form is section G), Submit an event goes to /events/new on Frequency where a chapter event waits for a central admin's yes, the footer's Creative Collective link to the old site is gone, and the profile website is thegrouplocal.com. North Park's chapter text and its Team Up Tuesday event say North Park, not Normal Heights. Merch rows keep the store URL they were copied from in their details: a provenance note, never a visitor link, and the probe leaves those lines alone. June's email and the Calendly link stay; neither is the old site. Powered by Frequency was already footer-only (SCAN-1018). Production carries the same change as section C6 of the owner's SQL paste: string replacements scoped to the Network tree, so page edits made since the seed survive.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('scripts/seed-the-group.mts','utf8');const q=fs.readFileSync('scripts/seed-the-group.sql','utf8');const bad=[];const old=s.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).filter(l=>/thegroupcoastal\.com\//.test(l)&&!/thegroupcoastal\\.com\\/store\\/p\\//.test(l));if(old.length)bad.push('the seed still links to the old site: '+old[0].trim().slice(0,80));if(/Normal Heights/.test(s)||/Normal Heights/.test(q))bad.push('North Park still reads Normal Heights');if(!/businesses launched/.test(s)||!/rain or shine/.test(s)||!/chapters and growing/.test(s))bad.push('the brief stats are missing');const links=(q.match(/\"href\":\"https:\/\/www\.thegroupcoastal\.com[^\"]*\"/g)||[]);if(links.length)bad.push('the generated website still links to the old site: '+links[0]);if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-951: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
